command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,os,recovar,jax,yaml
from recovar import cuda_backproject as cb
r=Path.cwd().resolve()
assert Path(recovar.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(r)
assert Path(jax.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(r/'.pixi/envs/default')
assert len(jax.devices())==1 and jax.devices()[0].platform=='gpu'
assert jax.devices('cpu')
gpu=str(jax.devices()[0].device_kind)
assert gpu=='NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3',gpu
assert cb.cuda_available(),cb.cuda_unavailable_error()
assert Path(cb._loaded_lib_path).resolve()==Path(os.environ['RECOVAR_CUDA_LIB']).resolve()
old=yaml.safe_load(Path('/scratch/gpfs/CRYOEM/gilleslab/mg6942/em_dev/recovar_hia_pr158_baseline_20260906/pixi.lock').read_text())
new=yaml.safe_load((r/'pixi.lock').read_text())
assert old['environments']['default']==new['environments']['default']
assert all(p in new['packages'] for p in old['packages'])
for name in ('spa','cryo_et'):
    baseline=r/'tests/baselines/run_test_all_metrics/long_generated'/('perf_baseline_'+name+'.json')
    assert gpu in json.loads(baseline.read_text())
    assert not os.access(baseline,os.W_OK)
print(json.dumps({'recovar':recovar.__file__,'jax':jax.__file__,'jax_version':jax.__version__,'gpu':gpu,'cuda_library':str(cb._loaded_lib_path),'original_packages_unchanged':len(old['packages'])}))
